summary_for_children: Ash-Sharh means The Expansion. It promises twice that with hardship comes ease.
environment_concept: The path climbs a steep, stony stretch, then opens onto an easy, level meadow path (94:5-6). A heavy pack lies set down beside the way, a picture of a burden removed (94:2). Stones block part of the path and can be cleared. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A stony climb with boulders, a level meadow path, a heavy pack resting on a stone.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: With Hardship Comes Ease
story_library.children_narration: Everyone faces difficult moments. Surah Ash-Sharh reminds us that with hardship comes ease. It encourages perseverance and turning to Allah. Even when a challenge feels difficult, we can continue with patience and hope.

world_idea.title: The Mountain Passage
world_idea.description: Navigate an initially narrow mountain path that opens into a wide landscape. The physical journey symbolizes perseverance, not a literal Quranic event.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
